units.summary: New test passes unsorted, duplicated refs to CompactSelectedSeries and checks that compaction succeeds, all three series are evicted and one block is written. It covers the sort and dedup step added in db.go.
units.headline: Add test for unsorted duplicate refs in CompactSelectedSeries
units.reason: New test-only code; it cannot affect production behavior.

units.summary: The exported StaleHead type is renamed SelectedSeriesHead and its unexported field is renamed to selectedSeriesRefs, now of type seriesRefs. The type is documented as used only for compactions, so the runtime effect is limited to the rename. External importers of StaleHead would break at compile time.
units.headline: Rename StaleHead type to SelectedSeriesHead
units.reason: Rename of an exported type with its uses updated; compile-time impact only, no runtime logic change.

units.summary: The constructor is renamed from NewStaleHead and takes the renamed seriesRefs type. Construction logic is identical.
units.headline: Rename NewStaleHead constructor to NewSelectedSeriesHead
units.reason: Pure rename with the same body; callers in db.go are updated.

units.summary: Index now calls selectedSeriesIndex instead of staleIndex. The reader is the renamed equivalent, and the implementation lives in head_read.go, which is not shown.
units.headline: Index delegates to renamed selectedSeriesIndex
units.reason: Delegation to a renamed index builder; the real logic sits in head_read.go.

units.summary: NumSeries used to return the head-wide stale series count. It now returns the number of selected refs. This feeds BlockMeta.Stats.NumSeries for the blocks that are written, and it is now correct for non-stale selections.
units.headline: NumSeries now returns the selected ref count, not the head-wide stale count
units.reason: The returned value changed, and it feeds block metadata stats.
focus: Meta().Stats.NumSeries is now len(sortedByRef) rather than NumStaleSeries(); check that the compactor does not rely on it for preallocation or sizing
The count does not respect the mint/maxt slice, so every chunk-range block reports the same NumSeries

units.summary: The placeholder ULID for the in-memory view is renamed and its value changed to a new string. It is only used as the Meta() ULID of the view, but the value is visible in compaction meta and logs.
units.headline: Rename staleHeadULID constant and change its placeholder value
units.reason: Placeholder ID for a transient in-memory view, used only in Meta().

units.summary: Meta now returns the renamed ULID constant. Everything else is unchanged.
units.headline: Meta uses the renamed selectedSeriesHeadULID
units.reason: Only the constant it references changed; the method is otherwise identical.

units.summary: The String output and its comment wording changed from stale head to selected-series head. This only affects log and error text.
units.headline: String text now says selected-series head
units.reason: Only log and error text changed.
